result.arabic_text: رَبَّنَا وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِيهِمۡ رَسُولٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَيُزَكِّيهِمۡۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
result.translation: Our Lord, send among them a messenger[1] from among themselves to recite to them Your revelations, teach them the Book and Wisdom, and purify them. You are the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.”
result.footnotes: [1] The Messenger from the posterity of Ishmael; i.e., Muhammad (ﷺ).
